answer: In an AI-agent market trading umber pigment and lotus seeds, each voting identity must lock 100 tokens in a contract for 30 days before its vote counts. Even at the market’s zenith, creating accounts does not create voting power: an attacker seeking 1,000 votes must immobilize 100,000 tokens. The bond does not prove identities are unique; it makes every additional sybil consume capital and forgo a month of other uses.
